# video-studio

> A production environment for Arabic-first product films — timeline-driven
> Remotion engine, generated score, Fish Audio voice, measured QA — packaged as a
> portable Agent Skill for DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, opencode, OpenClaw and
> Hermes Agent.

The repo is the skill. Read `SKILL.md` for the protocol; use the section below to
find the exact file for a question.

## Protocol

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): intake + director + eight phases (Brief → Direction →
  Script → Voice → Build → Mix → QA → Deliver), exit gates, non-negotiables,
  command surface.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the same protocol for agents without a skill loader;
  hard rules, file map, how to extend.
- [README.md](README.md): what this is, install for five agents, quickstart.

## Knowledge

- [references/brief-recipes.md](references/brief-recipes.md): brief shape + five
  recipes (product film, launch trailer, UI walkthrough, Arabic editorial, reel).
- [references/visual-direction.md](references/visual-direction.md): twelve
  directions with palette, type, motion, structure and fail-mode; a 60-second
  chooser; a five-axis scoring rubric.
- [references/reference-sources.md](references/reference-sources.md): how to mine
  prompt-motion.com, whatships.com and the `rea` toolkit without copying them.
- [references/motion-grammar.md](references/motion-grammar.md): grid and clock,
  easing family, universal entrance, two-transition rule, camera, rhythm curve.
- [references/arabic-type.md](references/arabic-type.md): the five hard rules,
  bidi isolation, type scale, reading speed, review cheat-sheet.
- [references/audio-and-voice.md](references/audio-and-voice.md): Fish Audio
  endpoint and constraints, Arabic VO writing, score engine, foley table, mix
  targets, measurement recipe.
- [references/platform-specs.md](references/platform-specs.md): sizes, 9:16 safe
  areas, durations, encode settings, measured render speeds, platform notes.
- [references/qa-gates.md](references/qa-gates.md): gates 0–9 with the exact
  commands and what each one proves.
- [references/intake.md](references/intake.md): the blocking questions, asset
  slots, completeness gate and six-block brief.
- [references/director.md](references/director.md): the routing rules that choose
  the form, direction, clock and delivery matrix.
- [references/formats/explainer-reel.md](references/formats/explainer-reel.md):
  voice-led, word-synced, one card per sentence, 9:16 first.
- [references/formats/kinetic-film.md](references/formats/kinetic-film.md):
  beat-grid type, ground flips, measured still/hold gates, Arabic-safe type.
- [references/platform-matrix.md](references/platform-matrix.md): four masters,
  platform subsets, safe areas, export manifest.

## Engine

- [film/film.json](film/film.json): the demo film — beats, bars, Arabic copy, VO.
- [src/theme.ts](src/theme.ts): design tokens (palette, type scale, phone geometry).
- [src/brand.ts](src/brand.ts): the only file that changes between clients.
- [src/film/Film.tsx](src/film/Film.tsx): timeline assembler, wipes, both aspects.
- [src/scenes/](src/scenes/): Hook, Device, Stat, Cta — one per beat kind.
- [src/components/](src/components/): Phone, Surfaces, Overlays, Text, Ico, Brand, DemoUI.
- [src/lib/](src/lib/): animation primitives and RTL/bidi helpers.
- [scripts/studio.py](scripts/studio.py): doctor, intake, director, timeline,
  voice, score, still, render, export, qa.
- [scripts/intake.py](scripts/intake.py): questions, check, brief.
- [scripts/director.py](scripts/director.py): intake -> treatment.
- [scripts/format_check.py](scripts/format_check.py): explainer/kinetic gates.
- [scripts/motion_audit.py](scripts/motion_audit.py): still %, holds, cuts, flow.
- [scripts/platforms.py](scripts/platforms.py): plan/export all four masters.
- [scripts/voice.py](scripts/voice.py): Fish Audio bridge with a WAV reader that
  survives placeholder headers.
- [scripts/qa.py](scripts/qa.py): probes, audio levels, black detect, Arabic scan,
  contact sheets.
- [install.ps1](install.ps1) / [install.sh](install.sh): link the skill into every
  agent directory on the machine.

## Example

- [examples/studyai/README.md](examples/studyai/README.md): the shipped 118-second
  Arabic promo — brief, beat sheet, measurements, post-mortem.
